title: Stay-Length Reduction Schedule for Late-Cancelled Free Night Awards Stays
content:
The stay-length reduction of the stay's protected value applies to one of the Free Night Awards forfeited on a reservation cancelled after its deadline. It turns on the nights the cancelled reservation was booked for, as recorded on its Room Reservations record:

| Nights booked on the cancelled reservation | Stay-length reduction |
|---|---|
| At least 3 nights (upper stay-length nights) | 2000 points (upper stay-length reduction) |
| At least 2 nights but fewer than 3 | 1000 points (lower stay-length reduction) |
| Fewer than 2 nights, that is, a one-night stay | No stay-length reduction |

The stay-length reduction is taken off the stay's protected value once.

### Boundary pairs

| Booked nights | Reduction | Booked nights | Reduction |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | None | 2 | 1000 |
| 2 | 1000 | 3 | 2000 |
| 3 | 2000 | 6 | 2000 |

A reservation booked for 3 nights or any longer stay takes 2000 points; one booked for exactly 2 nights takes 1000 points.
